source:
field() {
    printf '%s\n' "$1" | cut -d , -f "$2"
}
before=$(cat before.csv)
after=$(cat after.csv)
total=0
work=0
idle=0
wait=0
steal=0
for column in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
    first=$(field "$before" "$column")
    last=$(field "$after" "$column")
    if test "$last" -lt "$first"; then
        printf 'Counter decreased\n' >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    change=$((last-first))
    total=$((total+change))
    case "$column" in
        1|2|3|6|7) work=$((work+change)) ;;
        4) idle=$change ;;
        5) wait=$change ;;
        8) steal=$change ;;
    esac
done
if test "$total" -eq 0; then
    printf 'CPU counters did not advance\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
printf 'work=%s%% idle=%s%% wait=%s%% steal=%s%%\n' "$((100*work/total))" "$((100*idle/total))" "$((100*wait/total))" "$((100*steal/total))"

field() {

a1=$(field "$before" 1)

if test "$b1" -lt "$a1"; then printf 'Counter decreased\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
d1=$((b1-a1))
a2=$(field "$before" 2)

d5=$((b5-a5))
a6=$(field "$before" 6)
b6=$(field "$after" 6)
if test "$b6" -lt "$a6"; then printf 'Counter decreased\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
d6=$((b6-a6))
a7=$(field "$before" 7)
b7=$(field "$after" 7)
if test "$b7" -lt "$a7"; then printf 'Counter decreased\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
d7=$((b7-a7))
a8=$(field "$before" 8)
b8=$(field "$after" 8)
if test "$b8" -lt "$a8"; then printf 'Counter decreased\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
d8=$((b8-a8))
total=$((d1+d2+d3+d4+d5+d6+d7+d8))

idle=$d4

steal=$d8
if test "$total" -eq 0; then

fi
printf 'work=%s%% idle=%s%% wait=%s%% steal=%s%%\n' "$((100*work/total))" "$((100*idle/total))" "$((100*wait/total))" "$((100*steal/total))"
